SELECT id, ds_id, db_type, schema_name, table_name, table_type, comment_text, semantic_tags, sample_stats, knowledge_source, confidence, verified, evidence, status, version, hit_count, error_count, create_time, update_time FROM kb_table WHERE ds_id = #{dsId}
AND verified = 1 AND status = 'active'
AND status <> 'deprecated'
AND (table_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR comment_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR semantic_tags LIKE CONCAT('%', '"', #{keyword}, '"', '%'))
AND table_name IN
#{tn}
AND UPPER(CONCAT(schema_name, '.', table_name)) IN
UPPER(#{q})
AND
semantic_tags LIKE CONCAT('%', '"', #{tag}, '"', '%')
ORDER BY verified DESC, confidence DESC, create_time DESC LIMIT #{topK}
